question: At the Eighth Session of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) Assembly held at Bharat Mandapam in October 2025, which of the following initiatives was launched to address solar waste and promote circularity in the solar sector?

options.text: SURYA – Solar Urban Rooftop Yojana for Asia
SUNRISE – Solar Upcycling Network for Recycling, Innovation & Stakeholder Engagement
JYOTI – Joint Yearly Outlook for Technology and Innovation
PRABHA – Programme for Rural and Bharat Household Access to Solar

solution:
The correct answer is __**SUNRISE – Solar Upcycling Network for Recycling, Innovation & Stakeholder Engagement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **SUNRISE** initiative, which stands for **Solar Upcycling Network for Recycling, Innovation & Stakeholder Engagement**, was officially launched during the **Eighth Session** of the **International Solar Alliance (ISA) Assembly**.
 
• The assembly was held at the prestigious **Bharat Mandapam** in **New Delhi** during **October 2025**, bringing together global leaders to discuss the future of solar energy.
 
• The primary objective of the **SUNRISE** programme is to address the burgeoning challenge of **solar photovoltaic (PV) waste** and to establish a robust framework for **circularity** within the solar industry.
 
• It focuses on the **upcycling** of end-of-life solar modules, ensuring that valuable materials such as **silver**, **silicon**, and **glass** are recovered and reintroduced into the production cycle.
